the piezoelectrical field in the In0.2Ga0.8N QWs grown on a NPSS is 0.7 MV/cm, and the strain reduction effect is 0.13 MV/cm.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the piezoeelectric field in InGn quantum wells can be effectively reduced by using a patterned sapphire substrate.
the strain in the GaN epilayer can be reduced by the NPSS, which leads to the reduction of the piezoeelectric field in the active region of the light-emitting diode.
